Zoe (Finance Ops): :bell: Short notice policy broadcast: starting today we9re introducing a temporary vendor onboarding freeze for international suppliers outside of NA/EU. This is to allow time for an expedited compliance review for cross-border contracts. Freeze applies to new vendors only; renewals and existing contracts unaffected.

Zoe (Finance Ops): If your team needs an exception (customer-impacting or time-sensitive), submit the vendor-exception form and include justification + expected $$ amount. Exceptions require Procurement + Legal signoff. Exception form: https://redwood.internal/forms/vendor-exception.

Marcus (FP&A): Teams with recurring international spend > $5k/month please notify FP&A by EOD so we can prioritize review. We9ll aim to process high-priority vendor exceptions within 48 hours.

Priya (Procurement): Quick notes: 1) For new cloud regions or partners, include SOC/ISO certs and local tax IDs in the form to speed approvals. 2) If the vendor is being paid via an existing marketplace contract, note the marketplace reference.

Devon (Eng): Is this going to block onboarding of a new monitoring vendor we need for an upcoming launch?

Priya (Procurement): Devon  please file the exception and mark "LAUNCH" in the subject; tag @Priya and procurement@redwood.com. We9ll escalate with Legal.

Expense Bot: Automated reminder  continue to submit receipts within 5 business days. Holdbacks may apply for late submissions during the freeze window.

Zoe (Finance Ops): Appreciate the cooperation. We9ll post an FAQ on Confluence shortly and announce when the freeze is lifted. DM me for urgent edge cases. :pray:
